# schema/max_event_field — valid spec produces no diagnostics and exits 0
# No testserver needed; validate performs static analysis only.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

# Exercises progress.max_event_field — the variant for APIs that don't expose
# a server-supplied "since" filter but whose events carry their own timestamps.
# advance() walks the accumulated events and picks the max value at
# event_time.path; the high-water mark is written to cursor.last_timestamp.
# This is the per-iteration counterpart of latest_event_timestamp for sources
# that return everything in one shot but where the operator wants to track
# the most recently seen event timestamp.

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    api_key:
      type: secret
      default: "test-bearer-token-12345"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.api_key}

requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/events

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: events

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  max_event_field:
    event_time:
      path: timestamp
    initial:
      lookback: "24h"

error:
  mode: standard
